extraction.text:
Professional Summary

Results-driven AI/ML professional with over 9 years of experience, including 4 years specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics, and 5 years in data visualization, business intelligence, and cross-functional team leadership. Demonstrated expertise in developing and deploying end-to-end AI/ML solutions, including Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs). Adept at leveraging data-driven strategies to address complex business challenges, optimize processes, and deliver measurable business impact.

Professional Experience	Skills

Assistant Manager – AI/ML · KPMG - Flipkart

Bangalore · May 2025 - Present

 Directed AI/ML initiatives to automate business processes, resulting in significant operational efficiencies and actionable insights.

 Collaborated with clients to identify high-impact AI use cases, design robust models, and implement scalable solutions.

 Mentored and guided teams in Python automation, ML workflows, and advanced analytics best practices, enhancing team productivity.

 Automated complex business processes using Python and ML models, reducing manual effort and turnaround time.

 Developed reusable automation frameworks to streamline future AI/ML deployments and accelerate project delivery.

Data Scientist · Accenture RMG

Bangalore · Sep 2021 - May 2025

 Led Generative AI and NLP projects, delivering business value through advanced analytics and innovative solutions.

 Applied advanced analytical techniques to extract actionable business information from documents and unstructured data.

 Delivered projects using Agile methodologies and version control tools such as Git and Bitbucket, ensuring timely and quality outcomes.

 Utilized AWS for scalable model deployment and research, improving model accessibility and performance.

 Researched and implemented BERT and LLMs to develop generic models for multilingual financial documents, enhancing model versatility.

 Collaborated with business teams to optimize models and incorporate feedback, resulting in improved project outcomes.

QlikView/QlikSense Developer · CTS

Chennai · Mar 2016 - Sep 2021

 Designed and developed data visualization solutions using QlikSense, aligning with client requirements and industry best practices.

 Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into actionable technical specifications.

 Conducted data analysis and modeling to create interactive dashboards, providing actionable insights for stakeholders.

 Optimized application performance by implementing best practices, resulting in improved efficiency and user experience.

 Provided ongoing client support and training, enabling effective utilization of data visualization tools.

 Managed end-to-end data integration processes, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms.

 Facilitated knowledge transfer sessions for team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

Programming Languages

Python

Deep Learning & AI/ML

Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Transformers

Large Language Models (LLM): BERT, GPT

Machine Learning Linear Regression Logistic Regression Naive Bayes

K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Decision Tree

K-Means Clustering DBSCAN

Bagging

Data Visualization Tools

QlikSense QlikView Power BI

Database & Cloud Platforms Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Oracle 11g

Domain Knowledge

Life Sciences

Logistics & Delivery Networks Finance

Core Competencies

AI-powered Predictive Analytics

LLM Fine-tuning & Prompt Engineering Qlik Solution Architecture

Agile Project Execution Team Building & Mentoring Data Visualization

Achievements

Projects

Flipkart AI/ML Automation Pipelines

 Designed and implemented ML-based automation pipelines to optimize repetitive workflows, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.

 Applied NLP techniques for text extraction and classification of unstructured business data, enhancing decision-making speed.

 Leveraged supervised learning models for anomaly detection and forecasting within key operational processes.

 Coordinated with cross-functional client teams to ensure smooth adoption of AI/ML solutions and provided knowledge transfer sessions for sustainable use.

RMG

Created a master dataset by integrating 7 diverse data sources, enhancing data completeness and improving model accuracy by 20%

Employed various classification models and utilized different metrics, achieving overall model accuracy of 88%.

Developed a generic function for data preprocessing and wrangling, including data profiling, cleaning, and outlier treatment, streamlining the data preparation process and reducing preparation time by 40%.

  Built a multipurpose Triage AI agent for a stock brokerage firm using MCP, enabling Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) on text and images, and natural language text-to-SQL queries.

 Developed an Agentic HR Workflow with LangGraph, building a scalable HR automation pipeline to handle queries on hiring, holidays, and leave policies, easily integrable with existing systems.

Education

AI/ML · Post Graduate University of Texas

Jul 2025 - Present

Computer Science · B.E

Park College of Engineering and Technology, Anna University

Jan 2011 - Jan 2015

Certificates

Google Certified Gen AI Leader QlikSense Data Architect

Microsoft Certified PowerBI Associate Qlik Replicate certified
